name: Primal M1
summary: Primal M1 is HokMind’s full-body biomimetic robot platform for digital characters, entertainment, brand presentation and immersive experiences. It combines a humanlike body and face with drive and interaction systems intended to produce facial expressions, poses and upper-body motion. Characters and interactive content can be customized for a venue or brand. It is a publicly announced prototype platform; autonomous walking and broad commercial delivery have not been verified. The cover is an official promotional rendering.
